result.summary: 本文提出最简单的测试时扩展方法：用 1,000 条精选样本 s1K 对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 做监督微调得到 s1-32B，并用 budget forcing 控制思考长度 [S1.p2]。s1K 依据难度、多样性、质量三条准则筛选，消融显示三者结合很重要 [S1.p3]。s1-32B 在竞赛数学上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%，并通过 budget forcing 将 AIME24 从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。作者开源模型、数据和代码，旨在以完全开放的方式推进推理研究 [Sx1.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在 o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。作者认为测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证，但复现工作依赖大规模强化学习或海量样本 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
However, despite the large number of o1 replication attempts, none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior.
The viability of this paradigm was recently validated by OpenAI o1.

method.text: 方法分两部分：数据方面，从 16 个来源收集 59,029 道题，用 Gemini Flash Thinking 生成推理轨迹，再按质量、难度、多样性三阶段筛选出 1,000 条 s1K [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。训练方面，在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上做监督微调，仅用 16 张 H100 训练 26 分钟 [S1.p2][S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。测试时使用 budget forcing：超过上限时强制插入思考结束符提前退出，想延长时抑制结束符并追加“Wait”鼓励反思 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We collect an initial 59,029 questions from 16 sources following three guiding principles.
Thus, we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity.
We perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of an off-the-shelf pretrained model on our small dataset requiring just 26 minutes of training on 16 H100 GPUs.
We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and optionally append the string “Wait” to the model’s current reasoning trace

experiments.text: 评估使用三个基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），基于 lm-evaluation-harness，温度 0 贪心解码，测准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。对比模型包括 OpenAI o1 系列、DeepSeek r1 系列、QwQ-32B-preview、Sky-T1-32B-Preview、Bespoke-32B 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。消融实验分别检验数据选择（随机、仅多样性、仅最长、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
MATH500 is a benchmark of competition math problems of varying difficulty.
GPQA Diamond consists of 198 PhD-level science questions from Biology, Chemistry and Physics.
we evaluate with a temperature of 0 (greedy) and measure accuracy (equivalent to pass@1).
We benchmark s1-32B against: OpenAI o1 series, closed-source models that popularized test-time scaling; DeepSeek r1 series
Only Quality (1K-random): After obtaining our high-quality reasoning chains from Gemini, we select 1,000 samples at random
In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.

findings.text: s1-32B 在竞赛数学上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24），并通过 budget forcing 将 AIME24 从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。它是样本效率最高的开放数据推理模型，仅用 1,000 条样本就显著优于基座 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。数据消融显示，随机选择、仅多样性或仅最长轨迹都明显更差（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而全量 59K 相比 1K 没有实质增益 [S1.p3]。测试时扩展方面，budget forcing 具有完美可控性、正斜率且取得最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
from 50% to 57% on AIME24
We find that s1-32B is the most sample-efficient open data reasoning model.
It performs significantly better than our base model (Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct) despite just training it on an additional 1,000 samples.
Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection.
Overall, we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score.

limitations.text: 作者明确承认 budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：性能最终会趋于平坦，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。此外，过度抑制思考结束符可能使模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者还指出，能否仅用 1,000 条样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples.
